title: SAP MM Consultant
summary: An SAP MM (Materials Management) consultant sets up and supports the part of SAP that handles buying, stock and supplier invoices. You sit between the procurement and stores teams and the SAP project or support team, turning business needs into system settings and fixing issues users raise.
dailyDuties: Configure purchasing, release strategies and pricing in SAP MM
Run workshops with procurement and stores users
Write functional specs for reports, forms and enhancements
Test changes and help users through acceptance testing
Resolve MM support tickets such as stuck POs or GR/IR issues
Prepare material and vendor data for migration
Coordinate MM-FI and MM-SD integration with other consultants
typicalTitles: SAP S/4HANA Sourcing and Procurement Consultant

skills.expectation: Configure and support SAP MM: purchasing, release strategy, inventory, valuation and invoice verification
Run workshops with procurement and stores teams and write functional specs
Map procure-to-pay processes as-is and to-be
Write test scripts and run unit, integration and user acceptance testing
Resolve support tickets within SLA on support projects
Train key users and explain fixes in plain words
Work with business users, FI and SD consultants and ABAP developers
Understand MM-FI integration such as account determination and GR/IR
Support purchase order IDocs and EDI with vendors
Read ABAP enough to debug and guide developers
Prepare and check data migration templates and reports in Excel
Work in SAP Activate or agile project phases

certifications.why: Helps senior consultants who lead workstreams
